description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Checker, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It provides functionality to match user agent strings against a set of signatures to identify bots or specific user agents, and to determine the type of user agent (returns 'bot').

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Checker
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop to identify specific user agents (primarily bots) based on signatures and determine the user agent type.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches a user agent string against known signatures to identify if it is a bot.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'bot' in this implementation.
